messages:
marie: Heads-up — onboarding run for raven-lite int8 (multilingual) shows funcall payloads failing parse for Arabic/Japanese inputs. Attached sample below :eyes:

ajay: can you paste the raw model output? streaming or non-streaming?

marie: streaming=true. Reproducer (raw model chunk):
```json
{"tool": "search", "args": {"q": "تحقق من النص — contains multibyte ", "lang": "ar"}}
```
But actual bytes we get back sometimes look like:
```json
{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"\udc80\udc81\ufffd","lang":"ar"}}garbage
```
The trailing 'garbage' is a couple of invalid bytes.

kevin: hmm. Two hypotheses: 1) streaming split in middle of UTF-8 sequence -> invalid escape when reassembled; 2) tokenizer emitting BOM/escaped surrogates under quantization. Do we see '\xef\xbb\xbf' anywhere?

marie: yes, in one trace we saw leading BOM: 0xef 0xbb 0xbf in payload hex. Also Content-Type is 'application/json; charset=utf-8'

luis: streaming boundary split is likely. Quick test: set streaming=false, disable prefix caching, and run same prompt. If non-streamed output parses, it's streaming reassembly bug.

ajay: I'll run non-stream mirror on dedicated canary with prefix_cache=false and kv_cache disabled. ETA 30m.

ops-bot: @channel Canary test job started: raven-lite-int8/mirror-run/1749456789 (job id 6789). Logs at https://ci/repro/6789

ajay: early result: non-streamed output parses fine. Looks like streaming chunk reassembly + multibyte char at chunk boundary.

kevin: plan: 1) add utf-8 reassembly sanity check in streamer to ensure we don't cut inside multibyte sequences; 2) add lossy utf-8 replace fallback in parse-repair path + metric tag 'encoding-repair'; 3) add multilang cases to funcall acceptance harness.

marie: thanks. I'll open an eval PR with Arabic/Japanese snippets and expected schema, and add a small fuzz that forces split boundaries across multibyte chars.

luis: i'll add a small test in runtime streamer to detect and adjust chunk edges (look for leading continuation bytes 0x80-0xBF).

ajay: picking up the harness PR + CI job. will link.

marie: perfect. ping me if you need repro artifacts. :+1:
